comment: Canonical hostile-element set — the read-seam element drift alarm (v1.28.85). Truth source: brain-server src/gate.rs HOSTILE_ELEMENTS. Consumers: (1) server Rust lib test (every listed tag through sanitize_read: opening, closing, uppercase, hostile-attribute shapes), (2) plugin vitest plugin/src/format.test.ts (every tag through stripHostileElements), (3) client cargo test client/src/main.rs (vendored mirror vs this file), (4) fork host fixture test via the parity-synced extension tree. Changing the server set without this file fails lane 1; changing any consumer without the server fails its lane. Version 1 pins the 26-name set that closes R-01.

elements.name: script
elements.reason: executes JavaScript by mere presence; script-src of every stored-XSS forge

elements.name: img
elements.reason: auto-fetch on render plus onerror/onload handler host

elements.name: noscript
elements.reason: DECIDED include: conditional-render element enabling JS/no-JS differential rendering (phishing cloak); wraps link/style payloads that strip independently, but the differential itself is hostile. Inner content survives as inert prose like every other set member.
